text:
Good Friday morning in New York City, where an American mink was recently spotted in the Bronx.
Here's what else is happening:
- The Federal Aviation Administration will fire two air traffic controllers after they left work early the night a jet collided with a fire truck at LaGuardia in March, killing two people.
- Ahead of the new school year, parents and teachers want answers from education officials on the use of AI in New York City Public Schools.
- “Dolly: A True Original Musical” will still open next year on Broadway on what would have been her 81st birthday, “as was Dolly’s wish.”
- The Trinidad and Tobago Parade in Brooklyn this weekend has been cancelled after the NYPD denied the organizers' permit.
- New York City's war on rats is taking a toll on other wildlife in the city.
- Harry Styles kicked off a 30-night residency at Madison Square Garden.
